subject: SCAN_MAP_FOR_BEAST -- the verified pan, and the two times the pan was not a pan
verified_episodes: 202 of 204 rows carrying recorded_at have verifier_ok true

failures.what_the_frames_show: before is the world map.  after is the city with the furnace-upgrade gift popup over it; the two refresh frames behind it are the city plainly, bottom tab bar with the wilderness tab unselected.  The pan left the world map.
before is the world map with a level-4 beast in view.  after is the 生存者试炼 event page.  The pan was not consumed as a pan here either; the client acted on a control instead.

what_both_failures_have_in_common: The same SWIPE 0.50,0.62 -> 0.50,0.30 at 600 ms was issued from a frame the classifier read as MAP, and the client did not pan the map: it navigated somewhere else (city, then an event page).  The fail-closed verifier refused to call either step proven, which is the correct answer and is why neither became a false success -- but the client had already left the page.
what_is_still_unexplained: the mechanism.  No probe has reproduced either misfire, the x=0.50 column does not overlap the icon the second one opened, and no hypothesis here is backed by a measurement.  Do not write a cause for this until a probe produces one.
escalation_note: SCAN_MAP_FOR_BEAST|BEAST_SCAN_NOT_PROVEN|SCAN_MAP_FOR_BEAST was escalated STUCK_15_MIN at 14:56 claiming no verified episode.  That claim was false at the time (96 verified episodes since the 13:42 failure) and the classifier now reads the episode stream instead of the clock.
why_this_is_recorded: Two independent negative samples of the gap between the gesture's intent and the client's reading of it.  They bound the reliability of the hop: 202/204 with a passing verifier, 2/204 where the pan was not a pan.
